description: [Read · free] Resolve up to 200 LinkedIn profile URLs and/or person_ids to people in your Flux graph, free. Each result has person_id, the stored LinkedIn URL, matched_via (exact / canonical / member_id / public_identifier / none), name, current title and company, and coverage: has_positions (job history on file), enriched_at, engaged_with_you (engagements on your posts), in_campaigns (how many of your campaigns include them) and connected_via (engaged / campaign / segment / pulled). Only people connected to you resolve: someone who engaged with posts you can see, is in your campaigns or segments, or whom you pulled or enriched. Anyone else comes back as matched_via "none", the same as an unknown URL. _meta.next_step is the enrich_people call (with its credit cost) that saves the unmatched URLs and fills job history for matched people who lack it. Use it to triage a list of URLs before spending credits. Pure DB read, no LinkedIn pull, 0 credits.

linkedin_urls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs, any form (vanity, /in/ACo…, trailing slash, utm params). 1-200.
